nodes.label: first-offense education alternative
nodes.accepted_statement: For a first OUI offense, the court may permit alcohol education to reduce the suspension to forty-five through ninety days for a driver over twenty-one or two hundred ten days for a driver under twenty-one.

nodes.label: over-twenty-one failure suspension
nodes.accepted_statement: The failed-test table assigns drivers over twenty-one a thirty-day suspension or suspension until the court case ends, whichever is shorter.

nodes.label: eighteen-to-twenty-one test failure
nodes.accepted_statement: The failed-test table assigns ages eighteen to twenty-one thirty days plus one hundred eighty days, with the additional period waivable through approved alcohol education for a first OUI case.

nodes.label: over-twenty-one refusal progression
nodes.accepted_statement: For drivers over twenty-one, refusing a chemical test brings one hundred eighty days with no prior OUI, three years with one prior, five years with two and lifetime with at least three.

nodes.label: eighteen-to-twenty-one refusal progression
nodes.accepted_statement: For the eighteen-to-twenty-one group, refusal brings three years plus one hundred eighty days with no prior or one prior OUI, five years plus one hundred eighty days with two priors and lifetime with at least three.

nodes.label: older youth refusal education
nodes.accepted_statement: For a first OUI case in the eighteen-to-twenty-one refusal group, entering approved alcohol education can waive the additional one-hundred-eighty-day suspension.
